title: Dead Drop
description: A whistleblower's account is about to be frozen. Replace the seizure order in the primary ledger and backup mirror. There is just enough time to keep them out of sight.
objective: Replace the order at Research vault AND Backup mirror.
condition: Below 65% trace: +100 cr / +20 XP. Each optional archive: +100 cr / +15 XP; all three pay XP.
aftermath: The whistleblower escapes the financial dragnet and releases a list of surveillance contracts. Aegis starts taking systems offline.

lore.title: Before the freeze
lore.text: MORROW / PRIORITY ORDER: Freeze the account at 06:00, before the hearing. The attached risk assessment contains no financial analysis; it lists the whistleblower's recent contacts instead.

lore.title: Mirror instructions
lore.text: Mirror operator's instructions: Confirm the replacement order in both stores. If the signatures agree, the automated review accepts the correction before the next batch. Do not leave a contradictory copy.

lore.title: The name on the list
lore.text: The whistleblower's last draft: They have a list of everyone who asked questions. I thought leaving the company would get me off it. Now I know why the surveillance contract was worth more than the bank.
